adjudication.rationale: In `packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts`, the new `loadUsers` wraps the Prisma query in a `try/catch` and, on `Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError`, throws `new HttpError({ statusCode: 400, message: error.message })`. This propagates the raw Prisma `error.message` to the requester (this handler is part of the booking flow, i.e., accessible to a booker), which can leak internal database/error details. The diff explicitly introduces this behavior.
